N1.s: Jatah %lld cutling gratis sudah terpakai. Lanjutkan ke Cutling, buka versi lengkap, dan cutling ini tersimpan.
N1.back: Allowance 5 cutling free already used. Continue to Cutling, unlock version complete, and cutling this saved.
N1.why: Opens with S3's 'Jatah … sudah terpakai' (without 'Anda', to fit 110) and uses the vocab's 'Lanjutkan' so the prompt matches the system's continue button; the three steps are what the person actually does, in order.

N2.s: Jatah %lld cutling gratis sudah terpakai. Buka versi lengkap di Cutling untuk menyimpan lagi.
N2.back: Allowance 5 cutling free already used. Unlock version complete in Cutling for saving again.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1; 'di Cutling' sends the person to the app because this Shortcut cannot take them there, and 'menyimpan lagi' is how a speaker says being able to save again, exactly 90.

N3.why: 'Tinggal' is the everyday word for what is left; '1 gratis' follows S1's count-plus-'gratis' pattern, and the comma keeps the capsule one breath.

N4.why: Same opening as N3, then S29's count pair word for word; '5 dari 5' shows the free places are filled without a second verb, within 30.

N5.s: %lld dari %lld terisi. Simpan di versi lengkap
N5.back: 5 of 5 filled. Save in version complete
N5.why: 'Terisi' is what Indonesians say of filled places or seats and sits after 'X dari Y' where 'penuh' would not; 'Simpan di versi lengkap' says that tapping saves this item by unlocking, exactly 40.

N6.why: The iOS verb for unlocking, and the only phrase that fits 10; bare 'Buka' would read as 'open', and the notice row above names 'versi lengkap'.

N7.s: Jatah %lld cutling gratis sudah terpakai. Buka versi lengkap agar cutling ini tersimpan.
N7.back: Allowance 5 cutling free already used. Unlock version complete so-that cutling this saved.
N7.why: N1's first sentence again so the limit has one wording; 'agar … tersimpan' ties the unlock to saving the item on this form, and 'cutling ini' points at it.

N8.s: Yang ini disisihkan untuk Anda. Buka versi lengkap di Cutling agar tersimpan.
N8.back: The one this set-aside for you. Unlock version complete in Cutling so-that saved.
N8.why: 'Disisihkan untuk Anda' is how a shop says it is holding something for you; 'Yang ini' avoids starting a sentence with a capitalised 'Cutling' that would read as the app's name.
